summary: Tax-jurisdiction mismatch after cross-ledger vendor merge prevents invoice finalization and payment
description: Issue summary: A recent vendor consolidation (merging two vendor records: VEND-7432 EMEA and VEND-19821 APAC) as part of the global vendor tidy-up has resulted in inconsistent tax jurisdiction codes stored across ledgers. Impact: Multiple vendor invoices for the consolidated entity are stuck in 'Pending Finalization' and failing payrun validation due to conflicting tax jurisdiction (VAT vs GST) and mismatched tax rates. This is blocking three scheduled payment batches (weekend payrun), affecting vendor settlements and month-end reconciliations. Environment: Production, EU and US ledgers. Root cause hypothesis: The vendor-merge script populated a single vendor header but did not correctly normalize the 'tax_jurisdiction' and 'vat_registration_country' mappings for ledger-specific tax engines. ERP (NetSuite) validation rejects the invoice finalization because tax calculation returns null for a subset of lines and flags a critical validation error (Tax jurisdiction absent for taxed line). Steps to reproduce: 1) Identify an invoice created post-merge for vendor consolidated ID (example INV-EMEA-00412). 2) Attempt finalization via Finance UI or API (PUT /erp/invoices/{id}/finalize). 3) Observe validation error in response and error code TAX-NULL-JURIS. 4) Confirm vendor header shows tax_jurisdiction="EU" while ledger-specific tax_country_code="GB" and tax_type="VAT" for EU ledger, but other ledger mapping shows tax_type="GST". Logs and references: - Finance dashboard payment batch: https://console.redwood/finance/payruns/2026-03-12-BATCH-7 - Slack thread: #finance-helpdesk thread ts 1648321123 - NetSuite record example: NS-INV-00412 - Data migration job: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/data-migrations!merge-88 (see migration run id 2026-03-09-17:23) Immediate business impact: delayed vendor payments across two regions and potential VAT reporting discrepancy for the month. Requested outcome: unblock invoices for payment while ensuring tax reporting integrity and fix root cause to prevent recurrence.

03/13 09:40 - Engineering: Reproduced validation failure in staging by applying same merge script; confirmed missing ledger_tax_map entry causes the tax engine to skip lookup.

resolution_notes: Workaround implemented (temporary): Finance Ops can perform a controlled manual finalization process by adding the missing ledger_tax_map entry for each affected invoice via admin tooling; steps documented in Confluence below. Use only for the 7 impacted invoices to avoid audit scope creep.

Permanent fix planned: Update data-migration merge script to include ledger_tax_map reconciliation and add unit/integration tests that validate tax mappings across ledgers. Deploy patch to prod window 2026-03-14 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Control and audit: Export of original vendor headers and post-fix records saved to S3 (s3://redwood-finance/audit/INT-770101/) for compliance. Tax team requested a review before month-end close.
